tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Liveness check. Returns ok and version. Free, no key.

tools.name: pricing_list
tools.description: List everything this server covers: every money_fact fact_key with an example question, and every scheme_lookup country. Free (nothing on this server is billed); call first if unsure whether a fact is covered.

tools.name: money_fact
tools.description: Get an official, dated personal-finance limit: deposit insurance (FDIC, FSCS, CDIC, AU FCS, NZ DCS) or contribution limits and allowances (UK ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA, pension annual allowance, Personal Savings Allowance; US 401k + catch-ups, IRA, Roth IRA, HSA; Canada TFSA, RRSP, FHSA; Austral

tools.name: scheme_lookup
tools.description: Identify a country's deposit-insurance scheme and its headline coverage (US FDIC, UK FSCS, CA CDIC, AU FCS, NZ DCS) with the regulator's URL and as_of date. country accepts ISO codes or names: US/USA, UK/GB, CA, AU, NZ. Free, no key.

tools.name: cross_border_check
tools.description: Answer cross-border money questions: deposit protection for non-residents, which schemes cover accounts held across borders. Returns sourced scheme information for both countries (from_country and to_country) with official regulator URLs and as_of dates. Covers US, UK, CA, AU, NZ. Free, no key. Unkn
